payload.claim: `_resets_at_fields` deliberately excludes `bool` from the "clean int" branch (`isinstance(resets_at, int) and not isinstance(resets_at, bool)`), but nothing constructs a `RateLimited` with a boolean `resets_at` in either test file, so the guard is unexercised. Dropping the `and not isinstance(resets_at, bool)` clause would let a boolean reopen time be stored and rendered as a real reopen time (`when(True)` is a valid, non-"unknown" timestamp) while every test in the diff still passes.
